title: docket proposal artifact
description: A proposal (rhiz-proposals/<id>.proposal.json) and its resolved form (<id>.resolved.json, the same object after review). docket-propose.py validates against this file; it uses only the keywords that tool's evaluator implements (type, enum, required, properties, items, minItems, minLength, $ref, if/then), so extend the evaluator before using another. Unlisted fields are allowed: an older or newer writer's extra field is not an error.

id.description: prop-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN; also the file name stem.

status.description: open: awaiting review. changes-requested: the agent owes a revision. approved / rejected: dispositioned. superseded: replaced by a later proposal.

weight_agent.description: The agent's weight, kept when the reviewer overrides `weight`.

weight.description: Roadmap DP-1. trivial: typo, formatting or link fix, approve commits it. standard: proposal, disposition, action. significant: intent, architecture or hypothesis, the full cycle. Absent reads as standard.

path.description: The file the change writes, relative to the governed repo.

before.description: Full original content; empty for a new file.

status.description: pending: unreviewed. approved: commit `after`. approved-working-draft: commit `after`, tagged working-draft. edited-commit-as-is: commit `reviewer_edit`. edited-for-agent: `reviewer_edit` is feedback for the agent. changes-requested: the agent revises. rejected: not committed.

reviewer_edit_mode.description: commit-as-is: the edit is final. agent-feedback: the edit is for the agent to reason about. null: no edit.

role.description: approval-note, change-request, rejection-rationale and edit-note accompany the matching resolution; general carries attachments or a note with no resolution.

path.description: A file-path reference, never an inline blob.
